concerns.text: Task T023c computes physical descriptors from 'raw elemental composition percentages' (data/processed/solder_hardness_cleaned.csv). This violates FR-003 and FR-014 which mandate computing descriptors 'on log-ratio transformed composition data'. The task explicitly contradicts the spec's mathematical requirement, creating a semantic weakening of the constraint.

Task T012d-Execute mandates halting execution with error 'NIST_UNVERIFIED_SOURCES' if sources are 'provisional'. This violates Constitution Principle VI (Materials Data Provenance) which requires ingesting data from 'published literature tables' regardless of verification status. The task creates a logical deadlock preventing the ingestion of the required literature data, effectively weakening the data provenance constraint.

Task T013 hardcodes the composition sum threshold logic to 'EXCLUDE' records if sum < 95% (read from config). While FR-002 uses '[deferred]' for the percentage, the task's rigid exclusion logic without a mechanism to report the actual pass rate (as required by SC-004) weakens the acceptance criterion. The task implements a filter but fails to preserve the requirement to measure and report the validation metric itself.

Task T027a is marked as 'rejected' in the revision notes (implied by context of broken dependencies) but is the sole task for SC-002 (paired t-test). The task list fails to provide a valid implementation path for SC-002, effectively dropping the acceptance criterion for model comparison significance.
